economy.summary: Voted against House Bill 1549, a statewide minimum wage increase, saying it would create a complicated, county-tiered wage system; says she prefers positioning businesses for expansion by eliminating regulatory barriers such as unnecessary regulations and permit hold-ups in state departments.
economy.short: Voted against minimum wage bill; prefers eliminating regulatory barriers.

taxes.summary: Her campaign pledges to oppose tax increases on Pennsylvania families, reject wasteful Harrisburg spending, and decline taxpayer-funded perks.
taxes.short: Opposes tax increases; pledges to reject wasteful spending, perks.

abortion.summary: Her 2022 campaign platform, as reported by PoliticsPA, included a pledge to protect innocent life; her current campaign site does not detail an abortion position.
abortion.short: 2022 platform pledged to protect innocent life; no current detail.

education.summary: Her campaign platform supports empowering parents with greater control over their children's education and curriculum decisions, expanding school choice options, and directing funding to classrooms over bureaucratic overhead.
education.short: Supports parental control over curriculum, school choice, classroom funding.

healthcare.summary: In a seniors-focused section of her campaign platform, says she will fight for legislation protecting seniors' financial security and access to affordable healthcare and prescription drugs; the platform does not detail a broader healthcare position.
healthcare.short: Pledges affordable healthcare, prescription drug access for seniors.

energy.summary: Her campaign platform supports energy independence through responsible use of Pennsylvania's natural resources, including clean coal and natural gas production, which she says keeps energy prices low while balancing job creation and environmental responsibility.
energy.short: Supports coal and natural gas production to keep energy affordable.

guns.summary: Her campaign platform pledges to defend every law-abiding Pennsylvanian's constitutional right to keep and bear arms, to provide police and first responders with resources, and to always oppose attempts to defund police.
guns.short: Pledges to defend Second Amendment rights; opposes defunding police.

economy.summary: Supports raising the minimum wage, saying every worker deserves a living wage that reflects the true cost of living, and proposes modernizing roads, bridges, and transit in underserved areas to create jobs.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage; proposes infrastructure investment creating jobs.

taxes.summary: Supports bipartisan efforts to lower Pennsylvania's Corporate Net Income tax rate, which he says is among the highest in the nation, to attract businesses to the state.
taxes.short: Supports lowering Corporate Net Income tax to attract businesses.

abortion.summary: Says women have the right to make decisions about their bodies without government interference and commits to safeguarding access to safe and legal abortion services.
abortion.short: Supports abortion access free of government interference.

education.summary: Advocates for well-funded schools so that every child can access quality education regardless of zip code, and ties improving education in the district to revitalizing its communities.
education.short: Advocates well-funded schools; quality education regardless of zip code.

healthcare.summary: Supports lowering prescription drug costs, expanding Medicaid, ensuring access to mental health services for all residents, and increasing funding for rural healthcare facilities.
healthcare.short: Supports lower drug costs, Medicaid expansion, rural healthcare funding.

energy.summary: Supports significant investments in renewable energy, public transit, and climate adaptation, says he is committed to creating permanent, high-quality, green union jobs, and advocates holding corporate polluters accountable.
energy.short: Supports renewable energy investment; holding corporate polluters accountable.
